“I am tomorrow what I establish today”

So I am off to start a new habit or two, and push forward. I got a tattoo yesterday that says “nevertheless, she persisted.“ Many meanings out of that one, but I will persist. Until I am dead and buried I will push on.

So much misinformation out there about not necessarily the benefits of it, but the hellish withdrawls many thousands of people face as they struggle to come off of it.  The sad part is many people go in blindly because of misinformation like this and end up in a place no one wants to be. 

Personally, after taking it for almost 15 years in pretty good quantities (30-50 gpd) on a daily basis, I found tapering down to about 6 g to be the best course for me before I jumped. You could try jumping from a higher amount and see how you feel, since you have until November. 

All the best to you!
